items.title: 7.3 Interference aur us ki aqsam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3 with Fig. 7.5 and Examples 7.1 and 7.2 (PDF 143-146).

blocks.text: Ek jaisi frequency wali aur ek hi simt mein chalne wali do waves ki superposition se jo phenomenon (waqia) hota hai, use interference kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do loudspeakers S1 aur S2 power amplifier P.A. se jure, jise oopar audio generator A.G. chalata hai. Neeche speakers ke mutawazi ek thos aur ek dashed lakeer; thos par P1, P3, P5 aur dashed par P2, P4. S1 aur S2 se nuqton tak raaste. P1 par microphone CRO se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(a): Sound waves ka interference dekhne ka tajrubati intezam (kitab ki Figure 7.5(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Speakers S1 aur S2, P.A. ke zariye A.G. se jure, gol wavefronts bhejte hain: S1 se magenta aur S2 se cyan qaus (arcs); thos qaus compressions aur dashed rarefactions. P1, P3 aur P5 wahan hain jahan ek jaise qaus katte hain; P2 aur P4 wahan jahan thos qaus dashed se katta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5 (b): Sound waves ka interference (kitab ki Figure 7.5 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do lagataar solid (ya dashed) arcs (qaus) ka faasla ek wavelength λ hai. P₁ par S₁ se 3½λ aur S₂ se 4½λ: farq λ, is liye awaz oonchi (constructive). P₂ par S₁ se 3½λ aur S₂ se 4λ: farq ½λ, compression rarefaction se milta hai aur awaz khatam (destructive). P₃ beech mein hai: farq zero.

Sound waves ka interference dekhne ka tajurbati set up Fig. 7.5(a) mein hai. Do loudspeakers S₁ aur S₂ ek Audio Generator (AG) se banne wali muqarrar frequency ki harmonic sound waves ke do sources hain. Chunke dono speakers ek hi generator se chalte hain, is liye woh ek hi phase mein vibrate karte hain. Aise sources ko coherent sources kehte hain. Ek sensitive (hassas) Cathode Ray Oscilloscope (CRO) se juda microphone sound waves ka detector (pakarne wala) hai. CRO aane wale signal ko apni screen par waveform ki shakal mein dikhata hai. Microphone ko baari baari loudspeakers ke saamne mukhtalif points par rakha jata hai, jaisa Fig. 7.5(b) mein hai.
Constructive Interference

Points P₁, P₃ aur P₅ par compression compression se aur rarefaction rarefaction se milta hai. Is liye superposition ke principle ke mutabiq yahan dono waves ke displacements jama ho jate hain aur CRO screen par bara resultant displacement nazar aata hai (Fig. 7.5-c).

blocks.alt: CRO ki screen, darjon wali cross ke sath, jis par bare displacement wali lehar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(c): Constructive interference: CRO ki screen par bara displacement (kitab ki Figure 7.5(c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CRO ki screen, darjon wali cross ke sath, jis par sirf pari axis par seedhi lakeer hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(d): Destructive interference: CRO ki screen par sifar displacement (kitab ki Figure 7.5(d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P1, P3, P5 par microphone ke paas dono lehrein ek sath pahunchti hain, to CRO bari lehar dikhata hai (Figure 7.5(c)). P2, P4 par ek ka compression doosre ke rarefaction se milta hai, to CRO par seedhi lakeer aati hai (Figure 7.5(d)).

blocks.title: Dilchasp haqeeqat (Interesting Fact)
blocks.text: White light mein sabun ki patli film (jhilli) par interference pattern banta hai; isi liye bulbulon par rang nazar aate hain.
Fig. 7.5 (b) se point P₁ par dono waves ka path difference (raaste ka farq) ΔS yeh hai:
Isi tarah points P₃ aur P₅ par path difference zero aur −λ hai. Yahan λ wavelength hai, yaani kinhi do lagataar solid ya dashed lines ka faasla.

blocks.title: Constructive interference
blocks.text: Jab bhi path difference wavelength ka poora multiple (integral multiple: 0, λ, 2λ, …) ho, to dono waves jama ho jati hain. Is asar ko constructive interference kehte hain.
Is liye constructive interference ki shart (condition) yeh hai:
Destructive Interference

Points P₂ aur P₄ par compression rarefaction se milta hai, is liye superposition ke principle ke mutabiq dono ek doosre ka asar khatam kar dete hain aur resultant displacement zero ho jata hai, jaisa Fig. 7.5(d) mein hai.
Points P₂ aur P₄ par dono waves ka path difference ΔS yeh hai:
Isi tarah P₄ par bhi path difference ½λ hai.

blocks.title: Destructive interference
blocks.text: Jin points par do waves ke displacements ek doosre ko khatam kar dein, wahan path difference aadhi wavelength ka odd (taaq) multiple hota hai (½λ, 3/2 λ, 5/2 λ, …). Is asar ko destructive interference kehte hain.
Is liye destructive interference ki shart yeh hai:

blocks.title: Example 7.1
blocks.problem: Do speakers figure ki tarah rakhe hain. Un ka darmiyani faasla 3.0 m hai aur woh 344 Hz ki mustaqil tone (awaz) nikalte hain. Ek microphone P ko speakers ko milane wali line ke parallel aur us se 4.0 m door ek line par chalaya jata hai. Sab se oonchi awaz tab sunai deti aur CRO par nazar aati hai jab microphone line ke beech (centre) mein ho aur jab har speaker ke bilkul saamne ho. Sound ki speed nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: S₁S₂ = 3.0 m, f = 344 Hz, speakers se P ki line tak faasla S₁P = 4.0 m, v = ?
Sab se oonchi awaz (constructive interference) ke liye path difference 0, ±1λ, ±2λ, ±3λ, … hona chahiye.
Beech wale point O par dono awazon ka path difference zero hai (S₁O = S₂O), is liye O par constructive interference hota hai.
Agla constructive point P hai, jahan path difference λ hona chahiye: λ = S₂P₁ − S₁P₁.
Right-angled triangle S₁S₂P₁ se (Pythagoras theorem): S₂P₁ = √((S₁S₂)² + (S₁P₁)²) = √((3)² + (4)²) = √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5 m.
Is liye λ = S₂P₁ − S₁P₁ = 5 − 4 = 1 m. Yahi constructive interference ka path difference hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: signal generator do speakers S2 (oopar) aur S1 (neeche) se jura. Un ke beech se ek lakeer 4.0 m door khari lakeer par nuqta O tak; us lakeer par S1 ke saamne microphone P, CRO se jura. Daen: hindsa (geometry), S2 aur S1 3 m door, lakeer 4 m door, O us ke beech, P S1 ke saamne, aur lakeeren S1O, S2O, S1P aur S2P.
blocks.caption: Example 7.1 (PDF page 145): 3.0 m door do speakers aur 4.0 m door lakeer par chalta microphone (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: O beech mein hai, is liye S₁O = S₂O aur path difference zero: oonchi awaz. P, S₁ ke bilkul saamne hai: S₁P = 4 m, aur right-angled triangle S₁S₂P se S₂P = 5 m, to farq 1 m = λ. Kitab ke chhote khaake mein O beech se hata hua hai aur hal wali S₂P lakeer saaf nahi; yahan O ko beech mein aur hal wala triangle S₁S₂P poora dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.2
blocks.problem: Ek radio transmitter ke signal ki wavelength 1500 m aur frequency 200 kHz hai. 1000 kHz par chalne wale transmitter ki wavelength kya hogi, aur radio waves kis speed se chalti hain?
steps: Diya gaya: λ₁ = 1500 m = 1.5 × 10³ m, f₁ = 200 kHz = 2.0 × 10⁵ Hz, f₂ = 1000 kHz = 1 × 10⁶ Hz; λ₂ = ?, v = ?; formula v = fλ.
Dono signals ki speed barabar hai (dono radio waves hain), is liye: v = f₁λ₁ = 2.0 × 10⁵ × 1500 = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹.
Doosre signal ke liye bhi v = f₂λ₂, to λ₂ = v/f₂ = (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(1 × 10⁶ Hz).
blocks.answer: λ₂ = 3 × 10² m = 300 m, aur speed v = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. Frequency 5 guna hui to wavelength 5 guna kam ho gayi (1500 m se 300 m).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye (For Your Information)
blocks.text: Monochromatic light (ek rang ki roshni): shole (flame) mein sodium chloride khalis peeli roshni deta hai. Yeh roshni red aur green ka mixture nahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Interference hone ki sharait kya hain, aur coherent waves aur coherent sources kya hain (short questions 7.1, 7.3)? Constructive aur destructive interference mein farq bataiye (short question 7.2).
blocks.explanation: Sources coherent hon, yaani ek hi frequency aur mustaqil phase difference wale (jaise ek generator se chalne wale do speakers); waves ek hi qism ki, taqreeban barabar amplitude ki hon, aur ek hi ilaqe mein milein. Constructive interference wahan hai jahan path difference wavelengths ka poora adad ho, to crest crest se (compression compression se) milta hai aur amplitude barhta hai; destructive wahan jahan aadhi wavelengths ka taaq adad ho, to crest trough se milta hai aur waves khatam ho jati hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Interference: ek jaisi frequency aur ek hi simt wali do waves ki superposition; coherent sources ek hi phase mein vibrate karte hain.
Constructive: ΔS = nλ, CRO par bara displacement. Destructive: ΔS = (2n + 1) λ/2, CRO par zero displacement.
Example 7.1: S₂P = 5 m, λ = 1 m, v = 344 m s⁻¹. Example 7.2: v = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, λ₂ = 3 × 10² m.
